subject.title: Discord: Support messageUpdate and messageDelete events for edit-to-reprocess and delete-to-cancel

question: Should Discord edit-to-reprocess and delete-to-cancel be default-on bundled plugin behavior, or should maintainers require opt-in or narrower semantics before landing https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/92091?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the proposed behavior changes live Discord session/cancellation semantics for existing users and needs maintainer product/default ownership before merge.

options.title: Accept default-on after proof
options.body: Land the linked PR direction once review and live Discord proof show edits reprocess and deletes cancel only the exact source message run.

options.title: Require opt-in config
options.body: Ask the PR to add a narrow Discord config gate or staged rollout before existing installations receive edit/delete reprocessing behavior.

options.title: Split edit from delete
options.body: Land edit-to-reprocess separately and keep delete-to-cancel on a narrower follow-up if cancellation semantics are not ready.

recommendation.title: Accept default-on after proof
recommendation.body: Land the linked PR direction once review and live Discord proof show edits reprocess and deletes cancel only the exact source message run.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history across the Discord monitor/startup/queue surfaces and prior review context for this exact feature gap.
